source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.1, Brownian motion (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Brownian motion kisi fluid (liquid ya gas) mein suspended (latke hue) chhote particles ki random (be-tarteeb) aur irregular (be-qaida) motion (harkat) hai. Yeh motion fluid ke molecules ke baar baar takrane se hoti hai. 1827 mein botanist (paudon ka mahir) Robert Brown ne microscope se dekha ke pollen ke chhote chhote particles liquid (pani) mein idhar udhar randomly ghoom rahe hain. Kitab kehti hai ke in particles ko dust (gard) ke particles samjha gaya. Baad mein sabit hua ke yeh motion molecules ki motion ka asar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab saal 1927 likhti hai; Brown ne yeh observation (ghaur se dekhna) 1827 mein kiya tha. Kitab Brownian motion ko 'gas mein molecules ki random motion' bhi kehti hai. Sahi baat yeh hai ke Brownian motion fluid mein latke hue chhote (magar nazar aane wale) particles ki motion hai, aur yeh motion aas paas ke na-nazar aane wale molecules ki takkar se hoti hai.

Gas ka molecule doosre molecule se takra kar apna rasta badal leta hai. Jab woh baar baar takrata rehta hai to us ka rasta random, zig-zag ban jata hai. Asal mein har collision (takkar) molecules ke darmiyan momentum aur energy ka len-den karti hai (Fig 13.1).

blocks.alt: Ek cube jaisa dabba jis mein taqreeban tees chhote gas molecules hain. Har molecule ke saath ek chhota arrow (teer) us ki velocity dikhata hai, aur arrows har taraf randomly ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Particles random motion mein hain (kitab ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Brownian motion randomness (be-tarteebi) aur chaos (afra-tafri) dikhati hai, is liye yeh randomness ke sab se saada models mein se ek hai. Is motion ki wajahein yeh hain:

items: Particle jitna chhota (aur halka), us ki speed utni zyada. Takkar se milne wala momentum halke particle ko zyada speed deta hai. (Kitab ise 'inversely proportional' (ulta tanasub) kehti hai; matlab yeh hai ke size barhe to speed kam hoti hai.)
Fluid ki viscosity (gaarhapan) barhe to particles ki speed kam hoti hai. Kam viscosity wale fluid mein Brownian motion tez hoti hai.
Viscosity fluid ke andar ki friction (ragar) ka measure (naap) hai, yani fluid ke behne ke khilaf resistance (rukawat).
Brownian motion fluid ke molecules/particles ko hamesha motion mein rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Albert Einstein ne 1905 mein samjhaya ke liquid mein pollen ke particles ki motion molecules ke dhakkon se hoti hai. 1908 mein French physicist J. Perrin ne experiment (tajurba) se Einstein ki baat sabit ki, aur is kaam par unhein 1926 ka Physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.prompt: Chhote particles bare particles se zyada tez Brownian motion kyun dikhate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhote particle ka mass kam hai, is liye molecules ki takkar se mila momentum us ki speed ko zyada badalta hai. Saath hi chhote particle par ek waqt mein kam takkarein hoti hain, is liye har taraf ke dhakke aapas mein poori tarah barabar (cancel) nahi hote aur woh idhar udhar jhatke khata hai.

items: Brownian motion: fluid mein latke hue chhote particles ki zig-zag motion, jo molecules ke dhakkon se hoti hai (Robert Brown, 1827).
Halke/chhote particles aur kam viscosity wale fluid mein motion tez.
Einstein (1905) ne samjhaya; Perrin (1908) ne experiment se sabit kiya (Nobel 1926).
